profile.name: generic_va_fald_miniled
profile.description: Placeholder VA mini-LED FALD set. Contrast is high on axis and falls off quickly with angle. Zone grid and PSF are round numbers, not a zone map from a shipping set.

input_domain: prepared float32 linear BT.709 RGB nits; bypass decode/spatial processing

definitions.rounding: integer floor ratios; object x uses round-to-even
definitions.trajectory: left-to-right at integer raster positions; black before/after

metrics.evidence: D under P model and P metric definitions

definitions.trail: positive excess Y behind moving rear edge in object-height band; exclude object; subtract independent matched black-only history for each arm
definitions.trail_energy: sum positive excess Y * dt over trailing pixels; nit-pixel-seconds, not joules
definitions.probe_variation: max-minus-min Y at fixed probe over full clip; includes requested content changes outside subtitle fixture
definitions.pumping_proxy: subtitle unchanged black-bar probe only; not perceptual flicker or PWM
definitions.zone_total_variation: sum absolute successive zone-command differences; nits
definitions.highlight_retention: integrated output Y in foreground mask / integrated requested Y in that mask
definitions.overshoot: positive excursion beyond held target in transition direction; falling residual is not overshoot
